_comment: Names of the desktop apps' controls as UI Automation reports them (Traditional Chinese UI, Claude 3.6556, Codex 26.1016). Change these, not the code, when an app update renames a control. Claude 3.6556 shows allow_once as its own button; more_allow is the fallback for builds that keep it in the dropdown. The Claude composer's model button reads "模型：Opus 5.5 高" and its menu lists the models as radio buttons (models: the ones the phone may pick; read 10/27); its usage button reads "使用量：每週 · 所有模型：46% 週日上午11:00 重設". Codex's model button reads "GPT-6.1 Sol 高" (model_prefix finds it, model_strip is removed before comparing): its menu has the item model_menu_item, which opens the models as radio buttons, and the effort menu button effort_menu; all of it works through UI Automation alone, even while the window is minimized (read 10/27). Claude's effort submenu (effort_item inside the model menu) opens only when the cursor rests on it; its radio buttons read "中 推薦", "最高 3.5× 或更多使用量" (label first). Claude's permission mode button is named after the current mode and expands to radio buttons "<mode> <description>". Codex's permission_button expands to menu items "<mode> <description>" and does not show the current one. Codex's effort is a slider driven by arrow keys (needs the window in front), so it is not switched from the phone. stop: the button Claude shows while a turn runs (Codex's was not seen yet). Codex's new-conversation page names its box new_edit instead of edit; Codex's stop button is also stop. Claude's sidebar entry is "<title>" or "<title> 由 Claude 從「…」啟動", next to "<title> 的更多選項" (menu_suffix) — the fallback when Claude ignores its links.
